meanings.usage: 指修道士、僧侣居住和进行宗教活动的场所
表示从一个地方移动到另一个地方的动作

meanings.meaning: 关隘（指山脉中可供通行的狭窄通道） verb. 通过

meanings.usage: 常用搭配connect A to/with B，表示把A和B连接起来
为及物动词，通常表示创立组织、机构等，过去式和过去分词为founded
指长途旅行的人，美式拼写为traveler
既可以指看门的犬只，也可比喻监督公共事务的个人或组织
指在山体、地下或海底开凿的通道
用来修饰动词，表示做事情没有经过慎重考虑
常用搭配make an attempt to do sth

meanings.meaning: 试图（常用搭配attempt to do sth，表示努力做有难度的事） noun. 尝试

meanings.usage: 指用栅栏、围墙等围起来的区域
表示天气或物体的冷热程度，常用搭配take one's temperature指量体温

meanings.meaning: 僧侣（指男性修行者，对应女性修行者为nun（修女））

meanings.usage: 表示不受他人打扰的私人空间或状态
表示没有固定方向地随意行走
指进行滑雪运动的人，动词形式为ski

phrases.usage: 引导原因状语从句，意为“既然；由于”，表示已知的事实或新出现的情况

examples.en: Now that a tunnel has been built through the mountains, the Pass is less dangerous.
examples.zh: 由于已经修建了一条穿山隧道，山口现在不那么危险了。

examples.en: Now that you have finished your homework, you can watch TV for a while.
examples.zh: 既然你已经做完了作业，你可以看一会儿电视。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，意为“派出；发出”，可接人或物作宾语

examples.en: The dogs are still sent out into the snow whenever a traveller is in difficulty.
examples.zh: 每当有旅行者遇到困难时，这些狗仍然会被派到雪地里去。

examples.en: The rescue team sent out three groups to search for the missing climber.
examples.zh: 救援队派出了三个小组搜寻失踪的登山者。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，意为“处于困境中”，在句中可作表语或后置定语

examples.en: We should give a hand to those who are in difficulty.
examples.zh: 我们应该帮助那些身处困境的人。

phrases.usage: 介词，意为“尽管；虽然”，后接名词、代词或动名词，引导让步关系

examples.en: Despite the new tunnel, there are still a few people who rashly attempt to cross the Pass on foot.
examples.zh: 尽管有了新隧道，仍然有少数人鲁莽地试图步行穿越山口。

examples.en: Despite the bad weather, we still held the sports meeting as planned.
examples.zh: 尽管天气不好，我们仍然按计划举办了运动会。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，意为“试图做某事；尝试做某事”，常指做有难度或风险的事

examples.en: Very few people attempt to cross the Pass in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天很少有人试图穿越山口。

examples.en: He attempted to climb the mountain alone, but failed due to the storm.
examples.zh: 他试图独自攀登那座山，但因为暴风雨失败了。

phrases.usage: 动词搭配，意为“比起B更喜欢A”，用于表达两者间的偏好

examples.en: The monks prefer winter to summer for they have more privacy.
examples.zh: 修道士们喜欢冬天胜过夏天，因为他们有更多的独处时间。

examples.en: I prefer coffee to tea when I need to stay up late working.
examples.zh: 我需要熬夜工作的时候，比起茶更喜欢喝咖啡。

phrases.usage: 被动语态搭配，意为“被允许做某事”，表示得到许可做某件事

examples.en: The dogs are allowed to wander outside their enclosure in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天狗被允许在围场外面闲逛。

examples.en: Students are not allowed to use mobile phones in class in most schools.
examples.zh: 大多数学校不允许学生在课堂上使用手机。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，意为“受到热烈欢迎”

examples.en: These young people always receive a warm welcome at St.Bernard's monastery.
examples.zh: 这些年轻人在圣伯纳德修道院总是受到热烈欢迎。

examples.en: The foreign visitors received a warm welcome when they arrived at the university.
examples.zh: 外国访客抵达这所大学时受到了热烈欢迎。

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句
grammar.definition: 对先行词进行补充说明，去掉之后不影响主句意思的完整性，和主句之间通常用逗号隔开 which指代物，who指代人，在从句中作主语或宾语，不能用that引导

examples.en: The famous monastery of St.Bernard, which was founded in the eleventh century, lies about a mile away.
examples.zh: 著名的圣伯纳德修道院建于11世纪，位于（离山口）约一英里远的地方。

examples.en: These friendly dogs, which were first brought from Asia, were used as watchdogs even in Roman times.
examples.zh: 这些友善的狗最初是从亚洲引进的，甚至在罗马时期就被用作看门狗。

examples.en: My elder sister, who works in Shanghai, will come back home next week.
examples.zh: 我姐姐在上海工作，她下周会回家。

grammar.title: 原因状语从句引导词for的用法
grammar.structure: 主句 + for + 原因分句
grammar.definition: for是并列连词，用来补充说明前一句内容的原因，语气比because弱，不能放在句首 通常用于书面语，对前面的事实进行解释说明，前后两个分句是并列关系

examples.en: During the summer months, the monastery is very busy, for it is visited by thousands of people who cross the Pass in cars.
examples.zh: 夏天的几个月里，修道院十分忙碌，因为有成千上万开车穿越山口的人来这里参观。

examples.en: The dogs have greater freedom, too, for they are allowed to wander outside their enclosure.
examples.zh: 狗也有更多的自由，因为它们被允许在围场外面闲逛。

examples.en: He stayed up late last night, for he had to finish his report before the deadline.
examples.zh: 他昨晚熬夜了，因为他得在截止日期前完成报告。

patterns.pattern: At + 具体高度/年龄/价格, it is + 最高级 + 范围

original.en: At 2,473 metres, it is the highest mountain pass in Europe.
original.zh: 它海拔2473米，是欧洲最高的山口。

imitations.en: At 8,848 metres, Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.
imitations.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰海拔8848米，是世界上最高的山峰。

imitations.en: At 14 years old, he is the youngest player in the national football team.
imitations.zh: 他14岁，是国家足球队里最年轻的球员。

patterns.pattern: For + 时间段, sth/sb have done sth

original.en: For hundreds of years, St.Bernard dogs have saved the lives of travellers crossing the dangerous Pass.
original.zh: 数百年来，圣伯纳德狗拯救了穿越危险山口的旅行者的生命。

imitations.en: For thousands of years, Chinese people have created splendid traditional culture.
imitations.zh: 数千年来，中国人民创造了灿烂的传统文化。

imitations.en: For nearly 10 years, this little library has provided free books for children in the village.
imitations.zh: 近十年来，这个小图书馆一直为村里的孩子提供免费书籍。

patterns.pattern: In winter/In summer, however, life + 地点 + is quite different.

original.en: In winter, however, life at the monastery is quite different.
original.zh: 然而到了冬天，修道院的生活就完全不同了。

imitations.en: In summer, however, life in this small coastal town is quite different.
imitations.zh: 然而到了夏天，这个海滨小镇的生活就完全不同了。

imitations.en: On weekends, however, life in the office building is quite different.
imitations.zh: 然而到了周末，这座办公楼里的生活就完全不同了。

lines.en: The Great St.. Bernard Pass connects Switzerland to Italy.
lines.zh: 圣伯纳德大山口连接着瑞士与意大利，海拔2,473O米，是欧洲最高的山口。

lines.en: At 2,473 metres, it is the highest mountain pass in Europe.
lines.zh: 11世纪建造的著名的圣伯纳德修道院位于离山口1英里远的地方。

lines.en: The famous monastery of St.. Bernard, witch was founded in eleventh century, lies about a mile away.
lines.zh: 几百年来，圣伯纳德修道院驯养狗拯救了许多翻越这道山口的旅游者的生命。

lines.en: For hundreds of years, St.. Bernard dogs have saved the lives of travellers crossing the dangerous Pass.
lines.zh: 那些最先从亚洲引进的狗，待人友好，早在罗马时代就给人当看门狗了。

lines.en: These friendly dogs, which were first brought from Asia, were used as watchdogs even in Roman times.
lines.zh: 如今由于山里开挖了隧道，翻越山口已不那么危险了。

lines.en: Now that a tunnel ahs been built through the mountains, the Pass is less dangerous, but each year, the dogs are still sent out into the snow whenever a traveller is in difficulty.
lines.zh: 但每年还要派狗到雪山地里去帮助那些遇到困难的旅游者，尽管修通了隧道，但仍有一些人想冒险徒步跨越圣伯纳德山口。

lines.en: Despite the new tunnel, there are still a few people who rashly attempt to cross the Pass on foot.
lines.zh: 夏天的几个月里，修道院十分忙碌，因为有成千上万的人驾车通过山口，顺道来修道院参观。

lines.en: During the summer months, the monastery is very busy, for it is visited by thousands of people who cross the Pass in cars.
lines.zh: 由于来人太多，狗被关在专门的围栏里。

lines.en: As there are so many people about, the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure .
lines.zh: 然而到了冬天，修道院里的生活则是另一番景象。

lines.en: In winter, however, life at the monastery is quite different.
lines.zh: 气温下降到零下30度，试图跨越山口的人寥寥无几。

lines.en: The temperature drops to -- 30 o and very few people attempt to cross the Pass.
lines.zh: 修道士们喜欢冬天，而不太喜欢夏天。

lines.en: The monks prefer winter to summer of they have more privacy .
lines.zh: 因为在冬天，他们可以更多地过无人打扰的生活。

lines.en: The dogs have greater freedom, too, for they are allowed to wander outside their enclosure.
lines.zh: 狗也比较自由，被放出围栏，四处遛达。

lines.en: The only regular visitors to the monastery in winter are parties of skiers who go there at Christmas and Easter.
lines.zh: 冬天常来修道院参观的只有一批批滑雪者。他们在圣诞节或复活节到那儿去。

lines.en: These young people, who love the peace of mountains, always receive a warm welcome at St.. Bernard's monastery.
lines.zh: 这些热爱高山清静环境的年轻人每年都受到圣伯纳德道院的热烈欢迎。

questions.q: What are the St. Bernard dogs used for?
questions.zh: 圣伯纳德犬的用途是什么？
questions.a: They are used to save the lives of travellers who attempt to cross the dangerous Pass. The dogs are still sent out into the snow whenever a traveller is in difficulty.
questions.aZh: 它们用来拯救那些试图翻越危险山口的游客的生命。每当有游客遇险，它们就被派到雪地里去救援。
questions.hint: 见课文第4句和第6句：'St. Bernard dogs have saved the lives of travellers…' 及 '…the dogs are still sent out into the snow whenever a traveller is in difficulty.'

questions.q: Where is the famous monastery of St. Bernard located, and when was it founded?
questions.zh: 著名的圣伯纳德修道院位于何处？建于何时？
questions.a: It lies about a mile away from the Pass and was founded in the eleventh century.
questions.aZh: 它位于离山口约一英里处，建于11世纪。
questions.hint: 见课文第3句：'…the famous monastery of St. Bernard, which was founded in the eleventh century, lies about a mile away.'

questions.q: Why do the monks prefer winter to summer?
questions.zh: 修道士们为什么更喜欢冬天而不喜欢夏天？
questions.a: Because in winter they have more privacy, and the dogs have greater freedom, since they are allowed to wander outside their enclosure.
questions.aZh: 因为冬天他们能有更多无人打扰的清静，而狗也更自由，可以被放出围栏到外面四处遛达。
questions.hint: 见课文：'The monks prefer winter to summer for they have more privacy.' 及 'The dogs have greater freedom, too…'。

questions.q: What happens to the dogs during the summer months, and why?
questions.zh: 夏天的时候狗会被怎样对待？原因是什么？
questions.a: They have to be kept in a special enclosure, because there are so many people about—thousands of people visit the monastery in cars.
questions.aZh: 它们不得不被关在一个专门的围栏里，因为周围游客太多——成千上万的人驱车前来参观修道院。
questions.hint: 见课文：'During the summer months, the monastery is very busy…' 与 'As there are so many people about, the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure.'

questions.q: Despite the new tunnel, why do some people still rashly attempt to cross the Pass on foot?
questions.zh: 尽管有了新隧道，为什么仍有人鲁莽地徒步翻越山口？
questions.a: The tunnel makes the crossing less dangerous, but a few people still rashly attempt to cross on foot—perhaps for adventure or sport. That is exactly why the dogs are still needed today.
questions.aZh: 隧道让翻越山口不再那么危险，但仍有少数人鲁莽地徒步翻越——也许是为了冒险或运动。这也正是如今仍然需要这些狗的原因。
questions.hint: 见课文：'Despite the new tunnel, there are still a few people who rashly attempt to cross the Pass on foot.' 结合全文理解。

translation:
圣伯纳德大山口连接着瑞士与意大利，海拔2,473O米，是欧洲最高的山口。
11世纪建造的著名的圣伯纳德修道院位于离山口1英里远的地方。
几百年来，圣伯纳德修道院驯养狗拯救了许多翻越这道山口的旅游者的生命。
那些最先从亚洲引进的狗，待人友好，早在罗马时代就给人当看门狗了。
如今由于山里开挖了隧道，翻越山口已不那么危险了。
但每年还要派狗到雪山地里去帮助那些遇到困难的旅游者，尽管修通了隧道，但仍有一些人想冒险徒步跨越圣伯纳德山口。
夏天的几个月里，修道院十分忙碌，因为有成千上万的人驾车通过山口，顺道来修道院参观。
由于来人太多，狗被关在专门的围栏里。
然而到了冬天，修道院里的生活则是另一番景象。
气温下降到零下30度，试图跨越山口的人寥寥无几。
修道士们喜欢冬天，而不太喜欢夏天。
因为在冬天，他们可以更多地过无人打扰的生活。
狗也比较自由，被放出围栏，四处遛达。
冬天常来修道院参观的只有一批批滑雪者。
他们在圣诞节或复活节到那儿去。
这些热爱高山清静环境的年轻人每年都受到圣伯纳德道院的热烈欢迎。
title: A Famous Monastery
subtitle: 著名的修道院

lead.question: 著名的圣伯纳德修道院里，那些狗有什么用途？修道士为何更喜欢冬天？
lead.warmup: 在瑞士与意大利交界处，海拔2,473米的圣伯纳德大山口是欧洲最高的山口，11世纪修建的著名修道院就坐落在离山口约一英里处。几百年来，这里驯养的圣伯纳德犬在风雪中拯救了无数翻山者的生命。每到冬天，气温降到零下30度，修道院便归于宁静。走进这座修道院，感受它四季不同的生活。
goals: 读懂圣伯纳德大山口与修道院的地理位置及彼此距离
掌握圣伯纳德犬的来历与用途，分清现在完成时与一般现在时的用法
学会 now that、despite、whenever、prefer…to… 等连接与搭配的用法
体会修道院夏冬两季截然不同的生活景象
lead.summary: 圣伯纳德大山口连接瑞士与意大利，是欧洲最高的山口，11世纪修建的修道院距它约一英里。几百年来，院里驯养的圣伯纳德犬在风雪中救过无数翻山者；它们最早从亚洲引进，罗马时代便用作看门狗。夏天游客成千上万，狗被关进围栏；冬天客人稀少，气温低至零下30度，修道士得以清静，狗也更自由。
lead.tips: prefer A to B 的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，别误写成 prefer A than B，如 prefer winter to summer（喜欢冬天胜过夏天）。

exercises.q: 汉译英：几百年来，圣伯纳德犬一直拯救着翻越这道危险山口的旅行者的生命。
exercises.a: For hundreds of years, St. Bernard dogs have saved the lives of travellers crossing the dangerous Pass.
exercises.note: 现在完成时表持续结果

exercises.q: 汉译英：冬天，气温降到零下30度，很少有人企图翻越山口。
exercises.a: In winter, the temperature drops to minus 30 degrees and very few people attempt to cross the Pass.

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 Now that 改写 'As there are so many people about, the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure.'
exercises.a: Now that there are so many people about, the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure.

exercises.q: 填空：The monks prefer winter ______ summer because they have more privacy.
exercises.note: prefer A to B 固定搭配

exercises.q: 改错：Despite of the new tunnel, there are still a few people who rushly attempt to cross the Pass.
exercises.a: Despite the new tunnel, there are still a few people who rashly attempt to cross the Pass.
exercises.note: 去掉 of；正确词是 rashly

exercises.q: 填空：The dogs are kept in a special ______ so that they cannot wander about among the crowds.
汉译英：这些热爱高山清静的年轻人每年都受到修道院的热情欢迎。
exercises.a: These young people, who love the peace of the mountains, always receive a warm welcome at the monastery every year.

quiz.q: 根据课文，圣伯纳德犬最出名的是哪一点？
options: Saving the lives of travellers lost in the snow
Being a great summer tourist attraction
Pulling sledges for the monks in winter
Frightening away the skiers at the monastery

quiz.q: 填空：'For hundreds of years, St. Bernard dogs ______ the lives of travellers.' 空白处应填：
options: have saved
saved
are saving
save

quiz.q: 'Now that a tunnel has been built, the Pass is less dangerous.' 中 now that 的含义是：
options: Because / Since
Although
As soon as
In case

quiz.q: The monks prefer winter to summer 的意思是：
options: They like winter better than summer
They dislike both winter and summer
They like summer better than winter
They treat winter and summer equally
quiz.note: prefer A to B 喜A胜B

quiz.q: 与 'Despite the new tunnel, a few people still attempt to cross the Pass on foot.' 意思最接近的是：
options: Although a tunnel has been built, a few people still cross on foot
Because a tunnel has been built, nobody crosses on foot
The tunnel has stopped all people from crossing on foot
Since the tunnel is new, everyone crosses the Pass by car

quiz.q: 哪个词最能形容修道士们冬天安静的生活？
options: Solitary
Crowded
Noisy
Dangerous
